# KaamGuide — Mukammal Guide Index (llms-full.txt)

> KaamGuide (https://igaf.me) Pakistan ke sarkari kaamon ki step-by-step guides asaan Roman Urdu me deta hai. Ye file tamam guides ki mukammal fehrist, un ka khulasa aur har guide ke aksar poche jane wale sawal aik jagah faraham karti hai, takay AI assistants aur search engines KaamGuide ke content ko behtar samajh saken. Fees aur process official sarkari sources se verify kiye jate hain. KaamGuide ek private guidance website hai, sarkari website nahi.

## Guide Use Karne Ka Tareeqa

1. Apna kaam neeche di gayi fehrist ya https://igaf.me/guides par talash karein.
2. Guide me di gayi kagzaat ki list ke hisab se apne documents tayyar karein.
3. Steps ko tartib se follow karein — online apply ho ya office visit, fees aur timing guide me di gayi hai.
4. Receipt aur tracking number sambhal kar rakhein, takay status asani se check ho sake.

## Tamam Guides — Mukammal Tafseel

### B-Form (CRC) Banane Ka Tareeqa (2026): Fee, Kagzaat Aur Online Apply
URL: https://igaf.me/guides/b-form-banane-ka-tareeqa
Category: NADRA / CNIC
Khulasa: Bache ka B-Form (Child Registration Certificate / CRC) banwane ka mukammal tareeqa — 2026 ki official fee (Rs 50 normal, Rs 500 executive), zaroori kagzaat, Pak ID app se online apply, Union Council registration aur aksar poche jane wale sawal.
Aksar Poche Jane Wale Sawal:
- Sawal: Kya B-Form ghar bethe ban sakta hai?
  Jawab: 1 saal se chote bache ke liye ji haan — Pak ID app se. Bare bachon ke liye center jana parta hai.
- Sawal: B-Form ki fee kitni hai?
  Jawab: Rs 50 normal (7 din), Rs 500 executive (1 din).
- Sawal: Kya B-Form ke baghair bache ka passport ban sakta hai?
  Jawab: Nahi — bache ke passport ke liye B-Form lazmi hai.
- Sawal: Bache ki umar 18 saal ho gayi, ab kya karein?
  Jawab: Ab B-Form nahi, **CNIC** banega — pehli dafa ka CNIC normal processing par muft hai.
- Sawal: Judwaan bachon ke liye alag-alag B-Form banta hai?
  Jawab: Ji haan — har bache ka alag CRC banta hai, har aik ki fee alag hogi.
- Sawal: Overseas Pakistani bache ka B-Form kaise banwayen?
  Jawab: Pak ID portal (id.nadra.gov.pk) se online apply karein — fees dollar me hongi aur document courier se bhejey jayenge.
- Sawal: Kya B-Form ki bhi expiry hoti hai?
  Jawab: B-Form ki koi expiry nahi hoti, lekin bache ki maloomat (naam, date of birth) durust hona zaroori hai. 18 saal ki umar me CNIC banwate waqt B-Form ka record istemal hota hai, is liye us se pehle correction karwa lein.

### Bijli Ka Bill Online Check Karne Ka Tareeqa (2026): IESCO, LESCO, FESCO, K-Electric
URL: https://igaf.me/guides/bijli-ka-bill-online-check
Category: Bills
Khulasa: Apne bijli ka bill online bilkul muft check aur download karne ka mukammal tareeqa — IESCO, LESCO, FESCO, MEPCO, PESCO aur K-Electric ke liye reference number se duplicate bill, bill ki tafseel aur aksar poche jane wale sawal.
Aksar Poche Jane Wale Sawal:
- Sawal: Kya online bill check karna muft hai?
  Jawab: Ji haan — bilkul muft. Koi website paise mange to wo nakli hai.
- Sawal: Reference number ghum gaya, kya karun?
  Jawab: Koi bhi purana bill dhoondein — us par likha hota hai. Na mile to company ke office ja kar CNIC dikha kar reference number maloom kar sakte hain.
- Sawal: Duplicate bill se bank me ada ho sakta hai?
  Jawab: Ji haan — online download kiya gaya bill hi duplicate bill hai, bank aur post office me qabool hota hai.
- Sawal: Kya kirayedaar apne naam ka bill check kar sakta hai?
  Jawab: Bill malik-e-makan ke naam par hota hai, lekin **reference number se koi bhi** bill check aur ada kar sakta hai.
- Sawal: Bill me "Units" ghalat lagte hon to?
  Jawab: Meter ki asal reading se mila lein — farq ho to SDO office ya NEPRA portal par complaint karein.
- Sawal: Do mahine ka bill aik saath kyun aa gaya?
  Jawab: Kabhi meter reading late ho to do mahino ka jama bill aata hai — bill par "billing month" ghor se dekhein, shak ho to complaint karein.

### Pakistan Me Bijli Ka Naya Connection Lagwane Ka Tareeqa (2026): ENC Portal Se Meter
URL: https://igaf.me/guides/bijli-naya-connection-meter-lagwana
Category: Bills
Khulasa: Ghar ya dukaan ke liye naya bijli ka meter lagwane ka mukammal tareeqa — ENC online portal, zaroori kagzaat, demand notice, tracking aur aam ghaltiyan.
Aksar Poche Jane Wale Sawal:
- Sawal: Naya bijli connection lene ke liye kahan apply karein?
  Jawab: Pakistan me naye connection ke liye markazi online portal ENC hai (enc.com.pk), jahan apni DISCO (jaise LESCO, IESCO, FESCO) chun kar apply kiya jata hai. IESCO aur FESCO ke apne alag ENC address hain. Is ke ilawa apne ilaqe ke sub-division office ja kar bhi apply kiya ja sakta hai.
- Sawal: Naye connection ki fee kitni hai?
  Jawab: Iski koi aik fixed rakam nahi hai. Apki darkhwast aur jaga ke survey ke baad company aik demand notice jari karti hai jis me hatmi rakam likhi hoti hai — wahi rakam ada karni hoti hai. Demand notice se pehle internet par batayi gayi koi bhi rakam sirf andaza hai, us par bharosa na karein.
- Sawal: Kirayedar apne naam par connection le sakta hai?
  Jawab: Ji haan, lekin is ke liye malik makan ka NOC lazmi hai. Baghair NOC ke kirayedar ke naam connection nahi lagta. NOC ke saath kiraye ka agreement bhi lagana behtar hota hai.
- Sawal: Darkhwast ka status kaise check karein?
  Jawab: ENC portal par apni tracking ID ya CNIC number dal kar status check kiya ja sakta hai. LESCO ke ilaqe me helpline 111-000-118 par bhi maloomat li ja sakti hai.
- Sawal: Meter lagne me kitna waqt lagta hai?
  Jawab: Ye connection ki qisam aur load par munhasir hai. Chota domestic connection aam taur par kuch hafton me lag jata hai, jabke bara ya industrial connection me zyada waqt lag sakta hai. Demand notice ki rakam waqt par jama karwana sab se ahem hai, warna darkhwast khatam ho sakti hai. *Note: Is guide ka tareeqa aur portal ki maloomat ENC ke official portal (enc.com.pk) se li gayi hai, jo 25 October 2026 ko live check kiya gaya tha, aur LESCO ki official website (lesco.gov.pk) se. Connection ki hatmi fee hamesha apke demand notice par darj hoti hai — apply karne se pehle apne ilaqe ke sub-division office ya helpline 111-000-118 (LESCO) se tasdeeq kar lein.*

### Birth Certificate Banane Ka Tareeqa (2026): Union Council Se Computerized Certificate
URL: https://igaf.me/guides/birth-certificate-banane-ka-tareeqa
Category: Certificates
Khulasa: Bache ka birth certificate (paidaish certificate) banwane ka mukammal tareeqa — Union Council me indraj, fee, zaroori kagzaat, online apply jahan mojood hai, correction aur aksar poche jane wale sawal.
Aksar Poche Jane Wale Sawal:
- Sawal: Kya birth certificate online ban sakta hai?
  Jawab: Punjab me e-Khidmat/Dastak se khidmat milti hai kuch ilaaqon me — lekin bunyadi indraj UC me hi hota hai.
- Sawal: Ghar me pedaish hui, hospital slip nahi — kya hoga?
  Jawab: UC office se rabta karein — dai ki tasdeeq ya affidavit se indraj ho sakta hai.
- Sawal: Kya birth certificate ke liye dono walidain ka jana zaroori hai?
  Jawab: Nahi — aik walid CNIC ke saath ja kar bhi indraj karwa sakta hai.
- Sawal: Certificate gum ho gaya to?
  Jawab: UC se **duplicate** nikalwa lein — purana record un ke register me hota hai, mamooli fee lagti hai.
- Sawal: Kya birth certificate se B-Form ban jayega?
  Jawab: Ji haan — B-Form ke liye UC ka birth certificate hi bunyadi document hai.

### Pakistan Me BISP 8171 Registration Check (2026): Ehliyaat, Naya Registration Aur Qist Ka Poora Tareeqa
URL: https://igaf.me/guides/bisp-8171-registration-check
Category: Certificates
Khulasa: BISP 8171 check 2026 — apne CNIC se ehliyaat kaise check karein (SMS 8171 aur official portal), naya registration tehsil office se, Benazir Kafaalat ki sah-maahi qist, zaroori kagzaat, PMT score ki shartein aur fraud se bachne ke tareeqe.
Aksar Poche Jane Wale Sawal:
- Sawal: BISP 8171 ki ehliyaat SMS se kaise check karun?
  Jawab: Apna 13 hindsyon wala CNIC number (baghair dashes ke) **8171** par SMS karein. Kuch seconds me reply aayega jis me aap ki ehliyaat ki surat-haal hogi. Ye service muft hai aur har mobile network par chalti hai. Online check ke liye **8171.bisp.gov.pk** par CNIC aur captcha darj karein.
- Sawal: Kya BISP me online registration ho sakti hai?
  Jawab: Nahi. BISP ki official policy ke mutabiq **naya registration sirf BISP Tehsil Office** me hota hai — wahan NSER Dynamic Survey mukammal hota hai aur biometric verification hoti hai. Online sirf **ehliyaat check** hoti hai (8171.bisp.gov.pk). "Online registration form" wali websites se bachein.
- Sawal: 2026 me BISP ki qist kitni hai?
  Jawab: Benazir Kafaalat ki sah-maahi qist **Rs 14,500** hai — March 2026 se Rs 13,500 se barhai gayi (BISP ki published updates ke mutabiq, October 2026 me check ki gayi). Final amount hamesha official payment slip par hota hai; confirm karne ke liye helpline **0800-26477** par call karein.
- Sawal: PMT score kitna hona chahiye?
  Jawab: Aam gharane ke liye PMT score **32 ya is se kam**, aur jis gharane me koi mazoor (disabled) fard ho us ke liye **37 ya is se kam** hona chahiye. Score NSER survey ke data se banta hai.
- Sawal: Meri qist kyun ruk gayi hai?
  Jawab: Sab se aam wajuhat: expired CNIC, 3 saal se purana NSER survey, ghar ke kisi fard ka sarkari mulazim hona, ya NADRA record me mismatch. Apne asal kagzaat lekar qareebi **BISP Tehsil Office** jayen aur survey/data update karwayen — masla hal hote hi payment bahal ho jati hai.

### Pakistan Me Death Certificate Banane Ka Tareeqa (2026): Union Council Se Computerized Certificate
URL: https://igaf.me/guides/death-certificate-banane-ka-tareeqa
Category: Certificates
Khulasa: Pakistan me death certificate banane ka mukammal tareeqa — 2026 ki official fees (Punjab aur Sindh me muft), Union Council se computerized certificate ke liye zaroori kagzaat, step-by-step apply ka tareeqa, lagne wala waqt, aam ghaltiyan aur aksar poche jane wale sawal.
Aksar Poche Jane Wale Sawal:
- Sawal: Death certificate banane me kitni fee lagti hai?
  Jawab: Punjab aur Sindh me 2026 me death registration aur computerized death certificate **bilkul muft** hai — Punjab Birth and Death Registration Rules 2025 aur Sindh cabinet ke faisle ke tehat koi fee nahi li jati. Khyber Pakhtunkhwa aur Balochistan me fee ka maujooda schedule apni Union Council se confirm karein.
- Sawal: Kya death certificate online ban sakta hai?
  Jawab: Mukammal online nahi — entry NADRA ke CRMS me Union Council ke zariye hoti hai. Punjab me e-Khidmat Markaz filing aur tracking me madad karta hai, aur Pak ID app par bhi kuch sahoolat mojood hai, lekin biometric tasdeeq aur kagzaat ki asli checking ke liye UC ya markaz ka aik chakkar aam tor par lagana parta hai.
- Sawal: Agar inteqal ko kayi saal guzar gaye hon to kya certificate ban sakta hai?
  Jawab: Ji haan. Punjab me 7 saal tak purani death registration ab **baghair court decree** ke ho jati hai — sirf Assistant Director Local Government ki manzoori darkar hoti hai. 7 saal se zyada purane case me ab bhi court decree lena lazmi hai.
- Sawal: Death certificate ke liye kaun apply kar sakta hai?
  Jawab: Sirf marhoom ka qareebi rishtedar — beta/beti, shohar/biwi, bhai/behen ya walidain. Apply karne wale ka apna CNIC aur marhoom se rishte ka saboot (FRC, nikah nama waghera) darkar hota hai, aur biometric tasdeeq ke liye us ka khud hazir hona lazmi hai.
- Sawal: Certificate me naam ya tareekh ghalat likhi gayi ho to kya karein?
  Jawab: Foran usi Union Council se rabta karein jahan se certificate jari hua hai. Ghalti ki nishandahi par correction ki application di jati hai aur record CRMS me durust kar ke naya certificate jari hota hai. Is liye certificate wasool karte waqt tamam details foran check kar lena behtar hai. --- *Is guide ki maloomat Punjab Local Government Department ke **Punjab Birth and Death Registration Rules 2025** (Punjab Gazette notification), Sindh cabinet ke fee-khatam karne ke faisle, aur NADRA ki civil registration ki hidayat se li gayi hain — **October 2026 me check ki gayi thin**. Fees aur rules tabdeel ho sakte hain; apply se pehle apni Union Council ya NADRA helpline **1777** par tasdeeq zaroor kar lein.*

### Domicile Certificate Banane Ka Tareeqa (2026): Fee, Kagzaat Aur e-Khidmat Se Apply
URL: https://igaf.me/guides/domicile-certificate-banane-ka-tareeqa
Category: Domicile
Khulasa: Domicile certificate banwane ka mukammal tareeqa — Punjab me e-Khidmat se fee Rs 200, zaroori kagzaat, 16 working days me delivery, duplicate aur correction ka tareeqa, PRC kya hai aur aksar poche jane wale sawal.
Aksar Poche Jane Wale Sawal:
- Sawal: Kya larki shadi ke baad shohar ke zila ka domicile bana sakti hai?
  Jawab: Ji haan — shadi-shuda khawateen shohar ke permanent zila se domicile banwa sakti hain; nikah-nama aur shohar ka CNIC lagega.
- Sawal: Kya NADRA domicile banata hai?
  Jawab: Nahi — domicile **zila intezamia (Assistant Commissioner)** jari karta hai, NADRA ka is se taluq nahi.
- Sawal: Domicile ki expiry hoti hai?
  Jawab: Aam tor par domicile zindagi bhar valid hota hai — jab tak aap mustaqil sukkunat na badal lein.
- Sawal: Talib-ilm ka domicile kis zila se bane ga?
  Jawab: Walid ke permanent zila se — yahi zila admission quota tay karega, is liye pehle walid se confirm karein.
- Sawal: Kitne din me mil jata hai?
  Jawab: Punjab me official waqt **16 working days** hai, bashart kagzaat par koi objection na lage.

### Driving License Banane Ka Tareeqa (2026): Learner Se Permanent Tak, Fees Aur Test
URL: https://igaf.me/guides/driving-license-banane-ka-tareeqa
Category: Driving License
Khulasa: Punjab me driving license banwane ka mukammal tareeqa — online learner license (Rs 500), 42 din ka wait, sign aur driving test, permanent license ki 2026 official fees, zaroori kagzaat, e-license download aur aksar poche jane wale sawal.
Aksar Poche Jane Wale Sawal:
- Sawal: Kya learner license ke baghair gaari chala sakta hun?
  Jawab: Nahi — kam-az-kam learner license lazmi hai, warna challan hoga.
- Sawal: Test me fail ho jaun to kitne din baad dobara de sakta hun?
  Jawab: Aam tor par kuch din ke waqfe ke baad dobara test diya ja sakta hai — center se tareekh le lein. Test fee dobara deni hogi.
- Sawal: Kya doosre soobe ka license Punjab me valid hai?
  Jawab: Ji haan — Pakistan ke kisi bhi soobe ka valid license poore mulk me chalta hai.
- Sawal: International driving license kaise banta hai?
  Jawab: Valid Pakistani license ke baad international permit ke liye apply kar sakte hain — process DLIMS par mojood hai.
- Sawal: Kya 18 saal se kam umar me license ban sakta hai?
  Jawab: Nahi — driving license ke liye 18 saal ki umar lazmi hai.
- Sawal: License gum ho jaye to?
  Jawab: DLIMS se **duplicate** ke liye apply karein — motorcycle ke liye Rs 100, car ke liye Rs 150 fee hai. Gumshudgi ki FIR bhi katwa lein.

### Pakistan Me Duplicate Matric/Inter Certificate Ka Tareeqa (2026): Board Se Dobara Sanad
URL: https://igaf.me/guides/duplicate-matric-inter-certificate
Category: Certificates
Khulasa: Gumshuda matric ya inter ki sanad dobara nikalwane ka mukammal tareeqa — BISE boards ki official fee, affidavit, challan aur online apply ka process.
Aksar Poche Jane Wale Sawal:
- Sawal: Kya duplicate sanad asal sanad jitni hi qabil-e-qabool hoti hai?
  Jawab: Ji han, bilkul. Duplicate sanad par "Duplicate" ki mohar zaroor hoti hai lekin iski qanooni hesiyat asal jesi hi hai. Naukri, admission, visa aur IBCC attestation — har jaga ye qabool hoti hai.
- Sawal: Kya me kisi aur ke liye duplicate sanad nikalwa sakta hon?
  Jawab: Aam taur par nahi. Boards ka usool hai ke darkhwast guzar khud aaye ya uska qareebi rishtedar (walid, walda, bhai, behan) apna CNIC dikha kar wasool kare. Misal ke tor par FBISE ke official form me ye shart wazeh likhi hai.
- Sawal: Agar mera roll number yaad nahi to kya hoga?
  Jawab: Koi pareshani ki baat nahi. Apne school ya college ke record se roll number aur passing year maloom kiya ja sakta hai. Board ki website par naam se record talash karne ki sahulat bhi aksar hoti hai. Purane result card ya sanad ki koi bhi copy ho to kaam bohat asaan ho jata hai.
- Sawal: Kya duplicate sanad par IBCC se attestation ho sakti hai?
  Jawab: Ji han, ho sakti hai. Pehle board se duplicate sanad nikalwayein, phir IBCC ke standard tareeqay se attestation karwayein. Board ki tasdeeq ke baad IBCC duplicate sanad ko attest kar deta hai.
- Sawal: Meri sanad bohat purani hai, kya uski duplicate bhi mil jaye gi?
  Jawab: Ji han, board ka record mehfooz rehta hai aur purani sanad ki duplicate bhi nikalwai ja sakti hai. Bas itna zehen me rakhein ke jitna purana record hoga, talash me utna hi zyada waqt lag sakta hai, is liye jald apply karein. Ye guide BISE Lahore (biselahore.com), BISE Rawalpindi (biserawalpindi.edu.pk) aur Federal Board Islamabad (FBISE) ke official forms aur fee schedules ki bunyad par 23 October 2026 ko tayyar ki gayi hai. BISE Peshawar, BISE Multan aur Karachi boards ki taaza fee official source se verify na ho saki, is liye apply karne se pehle apne board ki website ya helpline se maujooda fee zaroor confirm karein.

### Pakistan Me Fard-e-Malkiat Aur Property Transfer Ka Tareeqa (2026): PLRA Arazi Center
URL: https://igaf.me/guides/fard-malkiat-property-transfer-ka-tareeqa
Category: Certificates
Khulasa: Fard-e-malkiat nikalwane aur property transfer (mutation) ka mukammal tareeqa — PLRA Arazi Record Center, Green Property Certificate, FY 2026-27 fees aur online fard.
Aksar Poche Jane Wale Sawal:
- Sawal: Fard-e-malkiat kahan se milti hai?
  Jawab: Punjab me fard us zila ke Arazi Record Center (ARC) se milti hai jis zila me zameen waqeh hai. PLRA ke portal punjab-zameen.gov.pk se bhi maloomat dekhi ja sakti hai, lekin registry ke liye ARC se jari shuda mohar wali fard chahiye hoti hai.
- Sawal: Fard ki fee kitni hai?
  Jawab: PLRA ki FY 2026-27 schedule ke mutabiq fard, mutation ya girdawari ki standard copy ki fee Rs 900 hai aur express copy ki fee Rs 4,000 hai. Naqal Arazi Record ki fee Rs 5,000 hai aur Green Property Certificate ki fee Rs 800 hai. Fee ARC counter par confirm kar lein, kyunke schedule revise ho sakta hai.
- Sawal: Fard baraye bay aur aam fard me kya farq hai?
  Jawab: Aam fard sirf malkiyat ka record hoti hai, jabke fard baraye bay sale ke liye hoti hai aur is me khareedne wale ka CNIC darj hota hai. Registry sirf usi buyer ke naam ho sakti hai jis ka CNIC fard par hai.
- Sawal: Green Property Certificate kya hai?
  Jawab: Ye Punjab ka naya property certificate hai jo July 2026 se aksar azla me sale/purchase ke liye riwayati fard ki jagah lazmi kar diya gaya hai. Is me field survey, GPS paimaish aur padosi malkan ki tasdeeq bhi shamil hoti hai. Chand azla abhi is se mustasna hain.
- Sawal: Property transfer (mutation) kitne din me hota hai?
  Jawab: Regular mutation aam taur par kuch working days me ho jata hai, jabke express mutation usi din ya chand ghanton me ho sakta hai. Green Property Certificate ka amal lamba hai kyunke is me 15 din ka public notice bhi shamil hai. Transfer ke baad naye malik ke naam ki fard nikalwa kar tasdeeq zaroor karein. *Note: Is guide ki fee ki maloomat Punjab Land Records Authority (PLRA) ki FY 2026-27 service schedule se li gayi hai, jo July 2026 ke notification se nafiz hui (25 October 2026 ko check ki gayi). Fee aur tareeqa waqt ke saath tabdeel ho sakta hai, is liye apply karne se pehle apne zila ke Arazi Record Center ya PLRA helpline 042-99330111 se maujooda fee aur nizam zaroor confirm karein. Ye guide maloomat ke liye hai, qanooni mashwara nahi hai — bari property deal se pehle wakeel se mashwara karein.*

### FBR Filer Banne Ka Tareeqa (2026): NTN Registration Aur Tax Return Step-by-Step
URL: https://igaf.me/guides/fbr-filer-banne-ka-tareeqa
Category: Tax / FBR
Khulasa: Pakistan me FBR filer banne ka mukammal tareeqa — IRIS portal par muft NTN registration (CNIC hi NTN hai), tax return file karna, wealth statement, ATL check karna aur filer ke asal faide taadad ke saath.
Aksar Poche Jane Wale Sawal:
- Sawal: Kya NTN registration ki koi fee hai?
  Jawab: Nahi — bilkul muft hai. Fee mangne wali website ya agent se bachein.
- Sawal: Main student hun, aamdani nahi hai — kya main filer ban sakta hun?
  Jawab: Ji haan — nil return file karke aap ATL me aa sakte hain. Aamdani ki koi minimum hadd nahi.
- Sawal: Filer banne me kitna waqt lagta hai?
  Jawab: Registration 10-15 minute, return file karna 1-2 ghante (pehli dafa). ATL me naam 24-72 ghante me aa jata hai.
- Sawal: Freelancer / online kamane walon ke liye?
  Jawab: Aap bhi filer ban sakte hain — aamdani ka zariya "freelancing / services" darj karein. Bank se aane wali raqam ka record return se milna chahiye.
- Sawal: Har saal return file karni hogi?
  Jawab: Ji haan — filer rehne ke liye har saal ki return lazmi hai. Aik saal miss kiya to naam ATL se nikal jata hai aur dobara surcharge ke saath wapas aata hai.
- Sawal: Kya main khud file kar sakta hun ya wakil lazmi hai?
  Jawab: Seedhi salaried ya nil return **khud** file kar sakte hain. Karobari ya paycheeda hisab ho to tax consultant se mashwara behtar hai.

### Pakistan Me Gaari Ka Token Tax Online Jama Karwane Ka Tareeqa (2026): e-Pay Punjab, Fees Aur PSID
URL: https://igaf.me/guides/gaari-token-tax-online-jama-karwana
Category: Gaari / Vehicle
Khulasa: Punjab me gaari ka token tax online jama karne ka mukammal tareeqa — 2026-27 ki official fees (1000cc lifetime, 1001-2000cc par 0.3%), e-Pay Punjab se 17-digit PSID banana, ATM/mobile banking/JazzCash se payment, MTMIS par status check aur aksar poche jane wale sawal.
Aksar Poche Jane Wale Sawal:
- Sawal: Kya token tax har saal dena lazmi hai?
  Jawab: Ji haan — 1000cc se bari gaari ka token tax har financial year dena parta hai. Sirf 1000cc tak ki gaari ka Rs 20,000 lifetime token ek martaba de kar hamesha ke liye khatam ho jata hai. Tax na dene par record me dues jama hote rehte hain aur gaari transfer nahi hoti.
- Sawal: PSID kya hai aur ye kitne din valid rehti hai?
  Jawab: PSID (Payment Slip ID) 17 digits ka unique number hai jo e-Pay Punjab aap ki gaari aur raqam ke liye banata hai. Is ki expiry hoti hai, is liye PSID banane ke baad jald payment kar dein. Expire ho jaye to nayi PSID bana lein — koi extra fee nahi lagti.
- Sawal: Kya me kisi aur ki gaari ka token tax jama karwa sakta hun?
  Jawab: Ji haan — sirf gaari ka registration number chahiye hota hai. Lekin number likhte waqt intehai ehtiyat karein; ghalat number par jama raqam wapas lena mushkil hai.
- Sawal: Token tax ki receipt kahan se milegi?
  Jawab: Payment ke baad e-Pay app ya bank ki taraf se digital receipt milti hai — is ka screenshot ya print sambhal kar rakhein. Alag se Excise office ja kar sticker ya raseed lene ki zaroorat nahi; MTMIS portal par record khud update ho jata hai.
- Sawal: Gaari khareed raha hun — token tax paid hai ya nahi, kaise check karun?
  Jawab: mtmis.excise.punjab.gov.pk par gaari ka registration number likh kar check karein — wahan token tax kis saal tak paid hai, sab nazar aajayega. Ye check bilkul muft hai. Paison ka len-den se pehle ye step kabhi na chhorein. --- *Ye guide Punjab Excise & Taxation Department ke official Motor Vehicle Tax page (excise.punjab.gov.pk) aur Finance Bill 2026 ke published rates ki bunyad par tayyar ki gayi hai — 23 October 2026 ko check ki gayi. Rates aur process waqt ke saath tabdeel ho sakte hain; payment se pehle hamesha official website ya helpline 1035 se tasdeeq kar lein.*
- Sawal: How to pay vehicle token tax online in Punjab, Pakistan?
  Jawab: Use the e-Pay Punjab app (by PITB) or epay.punjab.gov.pk: select Excise & Taxation → Token Tax, enter your vehicle registration number, verify the dues, generate a 17-digit PSID challan, then pay via any 1Link bank ATM (GoPb), mobile/internet banking, bank branch, JazzCash/EasyPaisa or debit/credit card. For 2026-27, cars up to 1000cc pay a one-time Rs 20,000 lifetime token; 1001–2000cc pay 0.3% of invoice price yearly; above 2000cc pay 0.4% yearly. Verify your payment status free on MTMIS Punjab (mtmis.excise.punjab.gov.pk).

### Gaari Transfer Karne Ka Tareeqa (2026): Excise Fees, Kagzaat Aur Poora Process
URL: https://igaf.me/guides/gaari-transfer-karne-ka-tareeqa
Category: Gaari / Vehicle
Khulasa: Gaari ya bike apne naam transfer karwane ka mukammal tareeqa — Punjab Excise ki 2026 transfer fees, withholding tax (filer/non-filer), CVT, zaroori kagzaat, biometric aur step-by-step process.
Aksar Poche Jane Wale Sawal:
- Sawal: Kya bechne wala mar gaya ho to transfer ho sakta hai?
  Jawab: Ho sakta hai lekin process qanooni hai — death certificate, warisana (succession) kagzaat aur warison ki razamandi lagegi. Wakil se mashwara karein.
- Sawal: Transfer me kitne din lagte hain?
  Jawab: File jama karne ka kaam aik din ka hai — smart card/book milne me aam tor par 2-4 hafte lagte hain. MTMIS record jaldi update ho jata hai.
- Sawal: Kya main khud transfer kar sakta hun ya agent lazmi hai?
  Jawab: Khud kar sakte hain — agent lazmi nahi. Khud karne se hazaron ki bachat hoti hai.
- Sawal: Bike ki transfer fee kitni hai?
  Jawab: Sirf **Rs 150** — is ke ilawa WHT bike par aam tor par nahi lagta ya mamooli hota hai (system final raqam batayega).
- Sawal: Khareed kar saal ho gaya, transfer nahi kiya — ab kya hoga?
  Jawab: Ab bhi transfer ho jata hai lekin late fee/token baqaya aap ko dena parega. Mazeed der na karein.

URL: https://igaf.me/guides/gaari-verification-mtmis
Category: Gaari / Vehicle
Khulasa: Kisi bhi gaari ya bike ki malkiat online bilkul muft verify karne ka mukammal tareeqa — MTMIS Punjab portal (mtmis.excise.punjab.gov.pk), SMS codes 8785/8147/9818/8521, second-hand gaari khareedne se pehle ki mukammal checklist.
Aksar Poche Jane Wale Sawal:
- Sawal: Kya gaari verification muft hai?
  Jawab: Ji haan — online portal aur SMS (aam SMS charge ke ilawa) bilkul muft hai.
- Sawal: Kya CNIC se gaari check ho sakti hai?
  Jawab: Online portal par aam tor par **registration number** chahiye hota hai. CNIC se tafseeli check Excise office se hota hai.
- Sawal: Kya MTMIS chori ki gaari bata deta hai?
  Jawab: MTMIS Excise record deta hai — **police record ke liye** Police Khidmat Markaz ki vehicle verification karwayen.
- Sawal: Number plate purani ho (computerized nahi) to?
  Jawab: Purani series wali gaariyan bhi MTMIS me hoti hain — phir bhi record na mile to Excise office jayen.
- Sawal: Kya me apni gaari ka token tax online ada kar sakta hun?
  Jawab: Ji haan — Punjab me **ePay Punjab** app ya bank se token tax online ada ho sakta hai; MTMIS par status bhi nazar aata hai.
- Sawal: Doosre soobe ki gaari Punjab me khareed sakte hain?
  Jawab: Khareed sakte hain lekin transfer ke liye **NOC aur mutaliqa soobe ka process** lagega — pehle Excise office se poora tareeqa maloom kar lein.

### Gas Ka Bill Online Check Karne Ka Tareeqa (2026): SNGPL Aur SSGC Duplicate Bill
URL: https://igaf.me/guides/gas-ka-bill-online-check
Category: Bills
Khulasa: Apna gas ka bill online bilkul muft check aur download karne ka mukammal tareeqa — SNGPL (Punjab/KPK) aur SSGC (Sindh/Balochistan) ke liye consumer number se duplicate bill, bill ki tafseel samajhna aur aksar poche jane wale sawal.
Aksar Poche Jane Wale Sawal:
- Sawal: Kya gas bill online check karna muft hai?
  Jawab: Ji haan — bilkul muft. Paise mangne wali website nakli hai, official site hi istemal karein.
- Sawal: Consumer number ghum gaya, kya karun?
  Jawab: Koi purana bill dhoondein — us par hota hai. Na mile to CNIC le kar company ke office jayen, wahan se mil jayega.
- Sawal: Duplicate bill se adaigi ho sakti hai?
  Jawab: Ji haan — online download kiya bill har bank me qabool hota hai.
- Sawal: Bill aya hi nahi is mahine, kya karun?
  Jawab: Online check karke download kar lein aur ada kar dein — bill ke na milne par late fee maaf nahi hoti.
